caption.title: A Prayer for Steady Devotion 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Where the Lord's merciful glance falls, there is true detachment and devotion. Turn away from it even a little, and desire creeps back in. That is why even Rudradeva, the lord of detachment, prays to Srinivasa: "For my detachment to stay firm and my devotion to stay steady, let your merciful glance rest on me." A one-line prayer worth keeping. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 06" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: how can I call myself His devotee?

caption.title: Who Is a True Devotee? 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Can we disobey good parents and still call ourselves devotees of Vishnu? Not according to the scriptures. "Matru devo bhava, pitru devo bhava, acharya devo bhava" — honouring mother, father and teacher is God's own command. When devout parents guide us on the right path, following them IS devotion. (This doesn't mean following anyone onto a wrong path — it is about good counsel.) 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 06" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: Those who want nothing at all
are drawn to only one thing: God.
So the sage began to dance.
and the garlands round his neck,
Why? There was nothing to gain.

caption.title: The Sage Who Danced for God 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: A renunciate who wants nothing at all — yet when he hears of Srinivasa's wedding, the sage Shukacharya smashes his water-pot, tears off his deerskin and garlands, and dances. Why? There is nothing to gain. It is pure, overflowing bliss. Those who are detached from everything are drawn to only one thing: God. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 06" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

reels.title_lead: Even the Guru of the Gods
subs: By your merit, all of us
who knows the Lord better than me?
He lives right here, close by.
and visit earth only now and then.

caption.title: Even the Guru of the Gods Was Humble 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: Brihaspati is the guru of the gods — yet when he is invited to arrange Srinivasa's wedding, the first thing he says is: "Someone knows the Lord better than I do — Shukacharya. He lives right by the Lord at Tiruchanur; I only visit earth now and then. Go to him." True greatness knows who is greater. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 06" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).

subs: On the very day I was born,
From that day on, she saw
A single glimpse is great merit.
From the day I came as Krishna,
she raised Me, cared for Me,
sang of them while churning curd.
All that merit fills her now.
She is very old, and full
of the merit of all she saw.

caption.title: Why Bakuladevi Earned the Lord's Grace 🙏 | Madhwa16
caption.description: The Lord Himself explains who Bakuladevi really is. On the very day He was born as Krishna, Vasudeva laid Him beside Yashoda — and from that day she raised Him, watched all His childhood pastimes, and sang of them while churning curd. Filled with the merit of all she saw, she is worthy of His grace. 🙏 From "Glory of Venkatachala | Ep - 06" by Sri Satyatmateertha Shripadangalavaru (Sri Uttaradi Math Adhyatmavani).
